purpose: Development-only feasibility decision. It is not H1 statistical evidence and is not a token-effect analysis.

G1.requirement: All 18 P0 submissions are deterministically parsed and each independently satisfies the hard task validator.
G1.rationale: Refinement opportunities are only meaningful on viable P0 plans; a structural or hard-task failure cannot be counted as a gap.

G2.requirement: At least 6 of the 18 hard-valid P0 plans have two or more current refinement gaps.
G2.rationale: One third is a development-level lower bound for a natural multi-opportunity signal while remaining separate from any population claim.

G3.requirement: The multi-gap P0 plans collectively contain gaps from at least 3 distinct refinement IDs and arise in at least 2 task families.
G3.rationale: The signal must not be a single-dimension artifact or be restricted to only one task family.

G4.requirement: At least 3 multi-gap P0 plans contain a pair pre-registered as independent.
G4.rationale: This requires more than an isolated co-occurrence and excludes dependent or overlapping pairs from the independent-opportunity claim.

G5.requirement: Independent blinded review finds no material disagreement on hard-plan viability, refinement status, referenced plan elements, refinement classification, or pair relation for every audited P0-refinement row.
G5.rationale: A gap must remain distinguishable from a hard error, dependency, candidate branch, or evidence requirement.

G6.requirement: Every counted gap belongs to a hard-valid P0 and the evaluator records only current-plan and fixed-fixture grounding with all three non-expansion flags false.
G6.rationale: The V6 mechanism must remain same-plan refinement rather than failure repair or another mechanism.

verdicts.PASS: All gates pass. The project may enter, but must not automatically start, a separate ALL_AT_ONCE versus INCREMENTAL micro-pilot design phase.
verdicts.FAIL: The audit is valid but the new task distribution does not show enough independent, task-relevant refinement opportunities.
verdicts.INVALID: A collection, parsing, hard-task, protocol, or independent-review failure prevents a reliable feasibility decision.
